record_title: Conjugate involutions yield non-bicircular generalized bi-circular idempotents
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Botelho--Miura's 2019 corrigendum is prior art showing that an earlier GBCI classification on differentiable-function spaces omitted a case and admitted additional examples. The claimed contribution is restricted to an explicit counterexample to the antipodal-or-BCI dichotomy in arXiv:2609.18967v1, the conjugate-linear interpolation lemma explaining the failure, and corrected semilinear block criteria for Miura Forms II--IV. The elementary lemma may be implicit in older real-linear/nonlinear idempotent literature; Form I and unrelated claims of the source paper are not challenged.
